candidate_merges.message: Fix ChildProcess completion-file race that stopped RemoteHost crash-loop recovery (#21945) ## What failed `IntegrationHostProcessTests.CrashLoop_StopsTheSessionAfterThreeRestartAttempts` failed on `main` ([run 42493145199](https://github.com/microsoft/aspire/actions/runs/42493145199), Hosting.RemoteHost on windows-latest) in 889 ms. The "failed after 3 restart attempts" log line was missing because supervision stopped after the first crash, before it tried any restart: ``` Failed to clean up pro
